items.title: My Happy Family
items.overview: In a patriarchal society, an ordinary Georgian family lives with three generations under one roof. All are shocked when 52-year-old Manana decides to move out from her parents’ home and live alone. Without her family and her husband, a journey into the unknown begins.

items.title: Norm Macdonald: Hitler's Dog, Gossip & Trickery
items.overview: Norm Macdonald delivers sly, deadpan observations from an older — and perhaps even wiser — point of view in this special.

items.title: Wonder Woman
items.overview: An Amazon princess comes to the world of Man in the grips of the First World War to confront the forces of evil and bring an end to human conflict.

items.title: Sarah Silverman: A Speck of Dust
items.overview: In her first comedy special post-health scare, Sarah Silverman shares a mix of fun facts, sad truths and yeah-she-just-went-there moments.

items.title: Bad Genius
items.overview: Lynn, a brilliant student, after helping her friends to get the grades they need, develops the idea of starting a much bigger exam-cheating business.
stream: Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads

items.title: Jawbone
items.overview: A former youth boxing champion, Jimmy McCabe is a man in search of hope but looking in all the wrong places. When he hits rock bottom he turns to his childhood boxing club and the only family he has left: gym owner Bill corner man Eddie and promoter Joe. Back in training, years after anyone thought he was a contender, he risks his life, as he tries to stand tall and regain his place in the world.
stream: Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads

items.title: Hasan Minhaj: Homecoming King
items.overview: Comic Hasan Minhaj of "The Daily Show" shares personal stories about racism, immigrant parents, prom night horrors and more in this stand-up special.

items.title: Hindi Medium
items.overview: Mita and Raj Batra, an affluent couple from Delhi’s Chandni Chowk, are grappling with getting their daughter admission into an English medium school. But there is one big problem. Their zubaan is Hindi, and the elitist snobs won’t let the Hindi speaking hoi-polloi fit in.

items.title: I Remember You
items.overview: After an older lady hangs herself in a church, a new psychiatrist discovers she was obsessed with the disappearance of his eight-year-old son, who vanished three years earlier. Meanwhile, three city dwellers are restoring a house when they realize it is haunted.

items.title: Abducted in Plain Sight
items.overview: A family falls prey to the manipulative charms of a neighbor, who abducts their adolescent daughter. Twice.

items.title: The Wizard of Lies
items.overview: A look behind the scenes at Bernie Madoff's massive Ponzi scheme, how it was perpetrated on the public and the trail of destruction it left in its wake, both for the victims and Madoff's family.

items.title: The Merciless
items.overview: Jae-ho, who aims to become the number one in a crime organization, gets to build up trust with Hyun-su, an ambitious newbie in prison. When they try to take over the organization after their release, their ulterior motives start to emerge.

items.title: Alien: Covenant
items.overview: The crew of the colony ship Covenant, bound for a remote planet on the far side of the galaxy, discovers what they think is an uncharted paradise but is actually a dark, dangerous world.

items.title: Time Trap
items.overview: A group of students become trapped inside a mysterious cave where they discover time passes differently underground than on the surface.

items.title: Shepherds and Butchers
items.overview: A lawyer takes on a case of a prison guard in South Africa who is traumatized by the executions he's witnessed.

items.title: Bon Cop Bad Cop 2
items.overview: Ward and Bouchard must face an important car theft ring that turns out to be a lot more than they bargained for: one where the stolen cars will serve as bombs in a well planned terrorist attack.

items.title: 47 Meters Down
items.overview: Two sisters on Mexican vacation are trapped in a shark observation cage at the bottom of the ocean, with oxygen running low and great whites circling nearby, they have less than an hour of air left to figure out how to get to the surface.

items.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales
items.overview: Thrust into an all-new adventure, a down-on-his-luck Capt. Jack Sparrow feels the winds of ill-fortune blowing even more strongly when deadly ghost sailors led by his old nemesis, the evil Capt. Salazar, escape from the Devil's Triangle. Jack's only hope of survival lies in seeking out the legendary Trident of Poseidon, but to find it, he must forge an uneasy alliance with a brilliant and beautiful astronomer and a headstrong young man in the British navy.

items.title: The Lovers
items.overview: The separation of a long married couple goes awry when they fall for each other again.

items.title: The Man with the Iron Heart
items.overview: With the Third Reich at its peak in 1942, the Czech resistance in London plans the most ambitious military operation of WWII –  Anthropoid. Two young recruits are sent to Prague to assassinate the most ruthless Nazi leader – Reinhard Heydrich, head of the Reich Security Main Office, the Gestapo and the architect of the Final Solution.

items.title: Everything, Everything
items.overview: A teenager who's lived a sheltered life because she's allergic to everything, falls for the boy who moves in next door.

items.title: Marlina the Murderer in Four Acts
items.overview: After encountering a group of bandits with plans to rape and steal from her, a young widow ventures into the wilderness in search of justice.

items.title: King Arthur: Legend of the Sword
items.overview: When the child Arthur’s father is murdered, Vortigern, Arthur’s uncle, seizes the crown. Robbed of his birthright and with no idea who he truly is, Arthur comes up the hard way in the back alleys of the city. But once he pulls the sword Excalibur from the stone, his life is turned upside down and he is forced to acknowledge his true legacy... whether he likes it or not.

items.title: War Machine
items.overview: A rock star general bent on winning the “impossible” war in Afghanistan takes us inside the complex machinery of modern war. Inspired by the true story of General Stanley McChrystal.

items.title: Marie-Francine
items.overview: A woman at the age of 50 moves back in with her parents after her husband leave her for a younger woman.

items.title: Chuck
items.overview: A drama inspired by the life of heavyweight boxer Chuck Wepner.
stream: IFC Films Unlimited Apple TV channel

items.title: The Wall
items.overview: An American sniper and his spotter engage in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with an Iraqi sniper.

items.title: The Levelling
items.overview: Clover is finishing a veterinary course when her brother dies and she is called home to her family's struggling Somerset farm.

items.title: Black Butterfly
items.overview: Paul is a down-on-his-luck screenwriter who picks up a drifter and offers him a place to stay. However, when the deranged stranger takes Paul hostage and forces him to write, their unhinged relationship brings buried secrets to light.

items.title: Risk
items.overview: Capturing the story of WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange with unprecedented access, director Laura Poitras finds herself caught between the motives and contradictions of Assange and his inner circle in a documentary portrait of power, betrayal, truth and sacrifice.

items.title: Snatched
items.overview: After being dumped by her boyfriend on the eve of their vacation to South America, impetuous dreamer Emily convinces her ultra-cautious mother Linda to step in as her travel companion. When the two are promptly kidnapped upon arrival in Ecuador, they must work through their differences to navigate the jungle and reach safety.

items.title: Lover for a Day
items.overview: After a bad breakup, a college-aged Parisian moves into her father's flat only to discover that he is living with his new girlfriend - a young woman her age.

items.title: Wakefield
items.overview: A man's nervous breakdown causes him to leave his wife and live in his attic for several months.

items.title: Lu Over the Wall
items.overview: In a small fishing village, a gloomy middle school student named Kai meets a mermaid named Lu.

items.title: God of War
items.overview: During the 16th century, pirates rule the Chinese coastline, pillaging the small villages and terrorizing the citizens. When maverick leader Commander Yu enlists the help of a sharp young general, they devise a plan to defeat the pirates. A violent clash of wit and weapons will decide who will rule the land.
stream: Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads

items.title: Everything You Want
items.overview: An aimless young troublemaker, Alessandro, squanders his days gambling and getting into fights, and he often spends his nights in jail. With few prospects, he begrudgingly accepts a job as a companion to Giorgio, an elderly poet suffering from Alzheimer’s. On their daily walks, the two banter and become friends, and Alessandro quickly learns more about this forgotten poet as the old man’s memory drifts. After learning a secret from Giorgio’s past, Alessandro and his friends work to uncover the mystery of this tale, an unexpected history lesson and a touching coming-of-age adventure.

items.title: Manifesto
items.overview: An edited version of Rosefeldt's installation work of the same name, Manifesto is an outstanding tribute to various (art) manifestos of the nineteenth and twentieth century, ranging from Communism to Dogme, in connection with thirteen different characters, including a homeless man, a factory worker and a corporate CEO, who are all played by Cate Blanchett. A striking humorous audio-visual experience.

items.title: Baywatch
items.overview: Devoted lifeguard Mitch Buchannon butts heads with a brash new recruit. Together, they uncover a local criminal plot that threatens the future of the Bay.

items.title: Churchill
items.overview: A ticking-clock thriller following Winston Churchill in the 24 hours before D-Day.

items.title: Double Lover
items.overview: Chloé, a fragile young woman, falls in love with her psychoanalyst, Paul. A few months later she moves in with him, but soon discovers that her lover is concealing a part of his identity.

items.title: Buster's Mal Heart
items.overview: An eccentric mountain man on the run from the local sheriff recalls the mysterious events that brought him to his present fugitive state.

items.title: Take Me
items.overview: Ray is a fledgling entrepreneur who specializes in high-end simulated abductions. He jumps at the chance when a mysterious client contracts him for a weekend kidnapping with a handsome payday at the end. But the job isn't all that it seems.

items.title: Message from the King
items.overview: On a relentless quest to avenge his sister's murder, a man from Cape Town infiltrates a sprawling network of lowlifes and elites in Los Angeles.

items.title: Deep
items.overview: In 2100, when humanity has abandoned the earth, a colony of extravagant creatures still thrives in the deepest abyss of the ocean.

items.title: Resident Evil: Vendetta
items.overview: When a fearless enemy out for revenge unleashes a brutal and deadly new virus, BSAA captain Chris Redfield enlists the help of Agent Leon S. Kennedy and Professor Rebecca Chambers to bring down the death merchant and save New York City.

items.title: Drone
items.overview: Ideologies collide with fatal results when a military drone contractor meets an enigmatic Pakistani businessman.
stream: Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads

items.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Long Haul
items.overview: A Heffley family road trip to attend Meemaw's 90th birthday party goes hilariously off course thanks to Greg's newest scheme to get to a video gaming convention.

items.title: The Dinner
items.overview: Two brothers and their wives meet up at a haute-cuisine restaurant to discuss what to do about a horrific crime that their sons committed together. As the quartet debate their options, the conversation reopens old wounds between the siblings.

items.title: Return to Montauk
items.overview: Author Max Zorn, now in his early 60s, is on a promotional book tour in New York when he encounters the woman he could never forget. They spend a weekend together, seventeen years have passed. Can there be a future for their past?

items.title: Half Girlfriend
items.overview: A boy meets a girl named Riya and falls in love. After struggling to convince her to be his girlfriend, she half-heartedly agrees to be his `half-girlfriend'.

items.title: Ismael's Ghosts
items.overview: Just as the disheveled and alcoholic filmmaker Ismaël embarks on a difficult new film project, his life is sent into a tailspin. His wife Carlotta, presumed dead for 20 years, come crashing back into his life creating chaos in his work and his current romantic relationship with the starry-eyed astronomer Sylvia.

items.title: Lucky
items.overview: The story of a young mother with a failed marriage behind her, who fights daily for her dream to open a hair salon, challenging her fate in an effort to free herself and gain independence and right to happiness.

items.title: Dirty Dancing
items.overview: Spending the summer at a Catskills resort with her family, Frances "Baby" Houseman falls in love with the camp's dance instructor, Johnny Castle, and nothing is ever the same for anyone in the Houseman family.
